A run starts here,
written by the api
Who writes each transition
1 received to queued, api: POST /events, with the job row
2 queued to running, worker: claim
3 queued to blocked_budget, worker: budget check before claim
4 queued to blocked_killswitch, worker: kill switch check at claim
5 running to queued, reaper: expired lease, attempts left
6 running to verifying, worker: agent returned an answer envelope
7 running to awaiting_approval, worker: human approval interrupt
8 running to escalated, worker: retry, call, or token limit reached
9 running to failed, worker or reaper: error, or attempts exhausted
10 running to blocked_budget, worker: token budget exhausted mid-run
11 running to blocked_killswitch, worker: kill switch before a model call
12 verifying to running, worker: a grader failed, retry within the cap
13 verifying to answered, worker: every grader passed
14 verifying to awaiting_approval, worker: reviewer concern persists
15 verifying to escalated, worker: final-answer grader failed at the cap
16 verifying to blocked_killswitch, worker: kill switch while verifying
17 verifying to failed, worker or reaper: error while verifying
18 awaiting_approval to running, worker: approval resumed the run
19 awaiting_approval to answered, api: approval of a held answer
20 awaiting_approval to rejected, api: POST /approvals/{run_id} reject
21 awaiting_approval to blocked_killswitch, api: kill switch engaged
22 answered to posted, worker: posted to the channel per autonomy policy
23 answered to awaiting_approval, worker: autonomy policy needs approval
The run goes on
A person decides
The run ends: posted
The run ends without a post
Every change is checked against the contract
and recorded as a run event in the same
transaction.
